description: Implement draft-ietf-jmap-filenode-13 method handlers. Defines FileNodeBackend trait. Registers 6 methods: FileNode/get (fetchParents traversal), FileNode/changes, FileNode/set (onDestroyRemoveChildren cascade, onExists collision handling: null/replace/rename, compareCaseInsensitively, nodeType inference on create, size server-set from blob, nodeHasChildren error type, circular reference prevention), FileNode/copy, FileNode/query (depth recursion), FileNode/queryChanges. Entry point: register_filenode_handlers. Spec: draft-ietf-jmap-filenode-13. Pattern: jmap-mail-server. Blocked by: jmap-filenode-types epic.
title: jmap-filenode-server: JMAP FileNode method handlers
